scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: rm -rf /tmp/esc-copy && tsc lib/escalationCopy.ts --outDir /tmp/esc-copy --module es2020 --target es2020 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck --types node && ESC_COPY_JS=/tmp/esc-copy/escalationCopy.js node --test tests/
scripts.test:recording: rm -rf /tmp/gsd-rec-test && tsc --outDir /tmp/gsd-rec-test --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck tests/recording-mode.test.ts && node --test /tmp/gsd-rec-test/tests/recording-mode.test.js
